text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- United Nations and European Union urge Ankara to withdraw its troops from northern Iraq.
- Egypt rejects Turkish incursion into northern Iraq.
- Jordan ready to maintain Iraqi civilian planes which have been in Amman since 1991 Gulf War.
- Iraq protests to Arab League against British, U.S. and French jets' violation of Iraqi air space.
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Spanish companies open medical exhibition in Baghdad.
- China to set up agriculture project in Iraq to develop strategic crops.
- Italian companies organise industrial fair in Iraq.
